name: National Scholarship Support
description: Financial support for eligible students pursuing higher education.
guidance: Students meeting the income and education conditions can explore scholarship application options.

name: Rural Skill Development Program
description: Skill-development support for people seeking employment opportunities.
guidance: Applicants with a rural profile can explore skill-development and employment-training opportunities.

name: Youth Employment Support
description: Employment-oriented opportunity for young job seekers.
guidance: Young applicants who are students or currently unemployed can explore suitable employment opportunities.

name: Farmer Welfare Assistance
description: Support opportunity for eligible farming households.
guidance: Applicants working in agriculture and living in rural areas can explore farmer-focused welfare assistance.

name: Higher Education Support
description: Educational support for students continuing higher studies.
guidance: Students pursuing graduation or postgraduate studies can explore higher-education assistance.

name: Urban Employment Assistance
description: Employment-oriented support for eligible urban job seekers.
guidance: Urban applicants seeking employment can explore suitable employment-support opportunities.

name: Government Competitive Examination Support
description: Support opportunity for candidates preparing for competitive examinations.
guidance: Graduates preparing for government competitive examinations can explore examination-support opportunities.

name: Low Income Family Welfare Support
description: General welfare-support opportunity for low-income households.
guidance: Applicants from lower-income households can explore welfare-support opportunities matching their profile.
